tracks.name: Meta-World v2原表 · ML10 · 元训练
tracks.version: arXiv v2 2021 benchmark report; no asserted modern package version
tracks.split: 10 meta-training skill families / 5 held-out meta-test families; meta-train
tracks.protocol: 39维状态型RL；任务ID不可见，依赖新交互进行梯度、递归状态或任务潜变量适应。Table 1跨任务/10种子最大成功率汇总；训练集和留出技能分开，不自造train+test总平均，不称零样本VLA。
tracks.trainingRegime: Meta-RL, no demonstrations; Appendix D: MAML 10 rollouts/task, RL² 10 rollouts/task, horizon500; PEARL probabilistic context with own sampling/update schedule. Not a common adaptation or compute budget.

results.sourceVersion: arXiv 1910.10897v2 (2021-06-14); native ar5iv Table 1 cross-checked with v2 PDF text, not CoRL 2019 table
results.locator: Table 1 lower half, ML10 meta-train; §4.3 and Appendix D.7–D.9
results.trainingData: Meta-RL, no demonstrations; Appendix D: MAML 10 rollouts/task, RL² 10 rollouts/task, horizon500; PEARL probabilistic context with own sampling/update schedule. Not a common adaptation or compute budget.
results.evaluationNotes: 原文正文/表注关于MT50及ML10/ML45最佳方法的说法与表内数值不一致，锁定Table 1数字并保留冲突。指标为原文10种子的average maximum success rate，不改成最终检查点；无误差栏则不补置信区间。不得与2019会议稿、图像BC或后续环境版本混排。
